annotations.title: Run Pre-Flight CAD Doctor & Instant Tier Quote

description: Run a free $0 read-only Pre-Flight CAD Doctor audit on a PCB (.kicad_pcb, .dsn, .ato, .tsx, or sample_id) and return a binding NRE quote without launching a billable job. Call before calligraphy_compile_board to verify outline, overlaps, and effective SKU pricing. Returns JSON effective_sku, final_price_usd, and pad counts. Example: sample_id='2l_rp2040', requested_sku='vibe_micro'.

customer_email.description: Engineer contact email for ECO license matching and compliance.

filename.description: Original CAD filename with extension used to select parser.

include_eco_pass.description: Add optional +50% 30-Day Unlimited ECO Re-Spin License surcharge.

preserve_existing_copper.description: Lock existing routed copper for surgical Rev-B ECO partial reroutes.

project_path.description: Local workstation path to CAD file (STDIO) or sample_id.

requested_sku.description: Target service tier SKU (vibe_micro, basic_2l, route_3d, turnkey_full).

rush_delivery.description: Add optional +35% Priority Enclave Rush turnaround queue surcharge.

target_nets.description: Optional list of specific net names for Rev-B ECO reroutes.

upload_b64.description: Base64-encoded binary CAD file or multi-file .zip project archive.

name: calligraphy_preflight_audit
